text.card: A red giant 1,162 parsecs away, 15 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded by TESS, give 0.82 solar masses and 15.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,407 K at its surface.
